title: Deferment of date of enforcement of Reg 28(9) of IRDAI(Registration and Operations of Branch offices of Foreign Reinsurers other than Lloyd’s) Regulations, 2015
full_text:
> **MllilMM INSURANCE REGULATORY AND ir.tai DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY OF INDIA Circular** 

# 

# 

**Re: Deferment of date of enforcement of Reg 28(9) of IRDAl(Registration and Operations of Branch offices of Foreign Reinsurers other than Lloyd's) Regulations, 2015** All CEOs/CMDs of all General Insurance Companies, Standalone Health Insurance companies & GIC Re. 

- October, 2015. The regulation 28(9) of IRDAl's (Registration and Operations of Branch offices of 

- Foreign Reinsurers other than Lloyd's) Regulations, 2015, defined the order of preference, in which the Indian Insurer shall offer for participation, in its facultative and treaty surpluses. This regulation was subsequently revised vide notification dated 28-01-2016. We understand that the insurers are currently in the process of making reinsurance 

- granted registration for commencement branch operation in India, so far, the Regulation 28(9) of IRDAl's (Registration and Operations of Branch offices of Foreign Reinsurers other than Lloyd's) Regulations, 2015, cannot be followed for the treaty placements, immediately. Therefore, if has been decided to defer the date of enforcement of Regulation 28(9) of IRDAl's (Registration and Operations of Branch offices of Foreign Reinsurers other than Lloyd's) Regulations, 2015, until further orders from the Authority.
